name: High Seas Fishing Charters
summary: A family owned, owner operated fishing charter running from the Careenage in Bridgetown on Ocean Hunter, a 42 foot custom built sportfisher. Trips of 4, 6 or 8 hours go after marlin, sailfish, wahoo, barracuda and mahi-mahi, for novices and experienced anglers alike. Tackle, bait, drinks and snacks are supplied.
standouts: 42 foot custom built sportfisher Ocean Hunter, takes up to 6 people
Captain Robbie has qualified for and fished the Rolex/IGFA Offshore Championship in Cabo San Lucas
Fully licensed, carrying all required safety gear and electronics

contact.address: The Careenage, Bridgetown, St Michael, Barbados
